title: Consistent Sellers
scenario: Identify products that have been sold in every year between 2008 and 2010. Return 'product_id'.
tableSchema: sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT)
hint: Filter for years 2008-2010, group by product_id, and ensure distinct year count is 3.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id FROM sales WHERE year IN (2008, 2009, 2010) GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT year) = 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1, 100, 2008, 1, 1), (2, 100, 2009, 1, 1), (3, 100, 2010, 1, 1);
